question: What kind of earth should be visualized beneath the wish-fulfilling tree?
premises: The meditation focuses beneath the tree.
The earth is the object of visualization.
The earth is devoid of the six waves.
inference: One should meditate on the earth beneath the tree as devoid of the six waves.
uncertainties: The specific six waves (ṣaḍūrmi) are not enumerated here.
plain_english: Beneath it, one should meditate on the earth, devoid of the six waves.
